sa.summary: Choose the temple style of your faith: cathedrals, mosques, Byzantine churches, dharmic temples, pagodas, fire temples and more, for any religion. Perfect for reformed pagans. No DLC required. English + French.
sa.desc:
[center][size=6][b]Sacred Architecture - Choose Your Temples[/b][/size]
[size=4]Give any faith the temples you want[/size][/center]

Reformed your pagan faith and tired of primitive-looking temples? Raise cathedrals, mosques or pagodas instead.

[size=5][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]New decision: [b]Choose a Sacred Architecture[/b] (religious decisions)
[*]10 styles: Latin Cathedrals, Byzantine Churches, Mosques, Dharmic Temples, Chinese Temples & Pagodas, Shinto Shrines, Fire Temples, Steppe Sanctuaries, Ainu Sanctuaries, Ancient Pagan Temples
[*]Temple holdings on the map change their look
[*]Requires being Head of your Rite or Head of Faith. Costs piety, 10-year cooldown. Player only.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Behind the scenes[/b][/size]
The game cannot change a faith's temple graphics mid-campaign, so the mod adds one empty faith per temple style for each religion. The decision moves your rite and all its followers into the faith with the chosen style. You stay in the same religion and keep your rite's name, doctrines and tenets. Everyone following your rite moves with you: create your own rite first if you only want your realm to change.

[b]Start a new game[/b] after enabling the mod: the temple faiths are created when a game starts, so it does not work in older saves. If the temples on the map don't change right away, save and reload.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]CK3 1.20 (1.20.1.2, rite system). No DLC required
[*]No vanilla file overwritten: works with all DLC and most mods
[*]Religions added by other mods need a compatibility patch: patches available for Polytheism Reborn Lite and RICE Unofficial Update
[*]English and French
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into [i]Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/[/i] (the [i]sacred_architecture[/i] folder and the [i]sacred_architecture.mod[/i] file), then add the mod to your playset in the launcher.


Idea by ChipopHQ. Made with the help of AI (Claude).

hc.summary: Conquer holy sites, sanctify them for your faith and exile rival faiths from them. Works for every religion, player and AI. No DLC required. English + French.
hc.desc:
[center][size=6][b]Holy Conquest - Sanctify and Exile Holy Sites[/b][/size]
[size=4]Conquer, sanctify, exile[/size][/center]

Holy sites are no longer frozen forever. Take a holy city by the sword, sanctify it for your faith, then exile the heretics and infidels who still pray there.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Sanctify a Holy Site[/b] (religious decision): any holy site in your realm becomes a holy site of your faith. 750 piety, 5-year cooldown.
[*][b]Exile Rival Faiths[/b] (religious decision): every other faith that venerates a holy site of your realm loses it. Eminent sites are demoted first. 500 piety + 250 prestige.
[*][b]Conquest event[/b]: when you gain a county with a holy site of another faith, choose to sanctify it, exile the other faiths, or wait.
[*]Exiled faiths lose fervor and their Heads of Faith hate you. Your faith gains fervor.
[*][b]Great holy sites[/b]: sanctify Jerusalem, Rome, Mecca, Constantinople or any site eminent for another faith: special event, 300 prestige, Conqueror of the Holy City bonus. The faiths that venerated it lose fervor and their Heads of Faith get the Holy City Profaned penalty. A pagan taking Jerusalem shakes Christians, Jews and Muslims at once!
[*]AI rulers can do it too (game rule).
[/list]

[size=5][b]Who can do it[/b][/size]
The Head of Faith, the Head of Rite, or any independent ruler with piety level 3+ (game rule). Works for every religion, reformed pagan faiths without a Head of Faith, and religions added by other mods.

[size=5][b]Rules[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Sanctify: the county is in your realm and held by a ruler of your faith. Your faith must have fewer holy sites than the maximum (9).
[*]Exile: the county's population must also follow your faith (convert it first). A faith never loses its last holy sites.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Game rules[/b][/size]
Who can sanctify, automatic exile when sanctifying, AI behaviour (off / rare / normal), conquest event (on / off).

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into Documents\Paradox Interactive\Crusader Kings III\mod (you get the folder holy_conquest and the file holy_conquest.mod), then enable the mod in your playset in the launcher.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]CK3 1.20 (1.20.1.2). No DLC required
[*]Does not overwrite any vanilla file and adds no faith: compatible with most mods
[*]English and French
[/list]

Idea suggested by ChipopHQ, inspired by the old "Dynamic Holy Sites" mod by Morven.
Made with the help of AI (Claude).

ce.summary: Dress your realm in any of 43 clothing styles, get 23 new aesthetics when diverging your culture, and buy innovations from other cultures for gold. No DLC required. English + French.
ce.desc:
[center][size=6][b]Cultural Exchange - Adopt Foreign Styles and Buy Innovations[/b][/size]
[size=4]Fashion, aesthetics and innovations without hybridizing[/size][/center]

Dress your court like the Persians, build like the Byzantines, or pay a neighbouring king in gold to teach your scholars what his people know. Your culture keeps its name, traditions and innovations.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Adopt a Foreign Fashion[/b] (decision): any of the 43 clothing styles of the game, for your whole realm. 300 prestige, paid only once you choose. 3-year cooldown. Your heir keeps it (game rule).
[*][b]23 new aesthetics[/b] in the vanilla Diverge Culture window (French, German, Russian, Greek, Persian, Egyptian, Bedouin, Andalusian, Castilian, Turkish, Mongol, Hindustani, Tamil, Somali, Ethiopian, Malinke, Han, Japanese, Korean, Tibetan, Khmer, Vietnamese, Malay): architecture, clothing, coat of arms, units and names. Diverging keeps your traditions, ethos and language.
[*][b]Buy Innovations[/b] (right-click a ruler of another culture): one random innovation (250 gold) or all you can learn (1000 gold). The seller gets the gold.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Game rules[/b][/size]
Foreign fashions on/off, heir keeps the fashion, who can buy innovations (Head of Culture / independent / any ruler / off), price (cheap / normal / expensive), new aesthetics on/off.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into Documents\Paradox Interactive\Crusader Kings III\mod (you get the folder cultural_exchange and the file cultural_exchange.mod), then enable the mod in your playset in the launcher.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]CK3 1.20 (1.20.1.2). No DLC required (some clothing styles need their DLC to show)
[*]Does not overwrite any vanilla file and adds no culture: compatible with most mods
[*]English and French
[/list]

Idea by ChipopHQ. Made with the help of AI (Claude).

og.summary: 10 neo-pagan faiths for cultures born Christian (French, Occitan, Italian, Castilian, Catalan, Portuguese, Dutch, English, Vlach...): 49 holy sites, a revival decision and a what-if start. No DLC. English + French.
og.desc:
[center][size=6][b]Old Gods Reborn - Neo-Pagan Faiths for Later Cultures[/b][/size]
[size=4]What if the French, the Dutch or the Castilians had gods of their own?[/size][/center]
Many cultures of CK3 were born already Christian. This mod imagines the faiths they could have kept: 10 reformed neo-pagan faiths, built from the real gods, sanctuaries and customs of each land.

[size=5][b]The faiths[/b][/size]
• [b]Druidism[/b] (French, Norman, Frankish): Lugus, the forest of the Carnutes, mistletoe and standing stones
• [b]Belenism[/b] (Occitan): Belenos the Shining One, sun worship, men and women equal
• [b]Cultus Deorum[/b] (Italian, Roman, Sardinian, Sicilian): Jupiter, the Lares, the Sibyl of Cumae
• [b]Disciplina Etrusca[/b] (Cisalpine, Lombard): Tinia, Uni and Menrva, haruspices reading the thunder
• [b]Celtiberism[/b] (Castilian, Asturleonese, Aragonese): Lugus, Numantia, sacred hospitality pacts, sky burials
• [b]Netonism[/b] (Catalan): Neto the Radiant, worshipped on Montserrat and the high peaks
• [b]Endovelicism[/b] (Portuguese, Galician): the healer Endovelicus and the Altar of the Sun at Finisterre
• [b]Nehalennism[/b] (Dutch, Frisian): Nehalennia, goddess of sailors and traders, with Wodan and Donar
• [b]Fyrnsidu[/b] (English, Anglo-Saxon): Woden, Thunor and Tiw, Stonehenge and Sutton Hoo
• [b]Zalmoxianism[/b] (Vlach): Zalmoxis, the holy mountain Kogaion and the wolf-dragon banner

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
• [b]4 new pagan religions[/b] (Gallo-Celtic, Neo-Roman, Paleohispanic, Dacian) + 2 new Germanic faiths
• [b]49 holy sites[/b] on real places, each faith with its own gods, priests, sacred texts, virtues, sins, tenets and doctrines
• All faiths are [b]reformed[/b]: they can stand against Christendom
• [b]Revive the Old Gods[/b] (decision, 500 prestige): your culture decides which faith you bring back. Your court and your counties of that culture convert with you, willing vassals may follow
• [b]Awakened start[/b] (game rule): what if they had never been Christianized? Christian counties and rulers of these cultures follow their old gods from day one (bishops and the Pope stay Christian)

[size=5][b]Game rules[/b][/size]
• Start: Dormant / Awakened (what if)
• Revival decision: on / off
• AI revivals: never / rare / common (zealous rulers never do it)
• Counties that convert: capital only / whole domain

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
• Made for CK3 1.20 (1.20.1.2). No DLC required
• Start a [b]new game[/b]: religions are created at game start
• Does not overwrite any vanilla file: compatible with most mods
• English and French

Idea suggested by ChipopHQ. Thanks!

li.summary: Awaken the Blood of Mars: become a Roman superhuman, then an immortal Imperator Invictus. Bloodline, maxed martial, seduction, legions, duels, conquest and the Imperium Invictum. No DLC required. English + French.
li.desc:
[center][size=6][b]The Blood of Mars flows in your veins[/b][/size][/center]
Your dynasty descends from Mars, the Roman god of war. Awaken the blood, grow from Son of Mars to immortal [b]Imperator Invictus[/b], pass the blood to your children and build the eternal [b]Imperium Invictum[/b].

[size=5][b]Three ranks of power[/b][/size]
• [b]Son of Mars[/b]: +35 prowess, +4 martial, knights x2, the body heals itself.
• [b]Legate of Mars[/b] (100 training): +80 prowess, +8 martial, bigger levies, more knights.
• [b]Imperator Invictus[/b] (300 training): [b]immortal[/b], +150 prowess, +15 martial, +8 to every skill, gold, levies +50 %, knights x5.
Train on the Field of Mars, fight wars and duels to grow stronger.

[size=5][b]Gifts of Mars: maxed martial and seduction[/b][/size]
• Rank 1: the highest martial education, Strategist, Seducer, Logistician and Aggressive Attacker.
• Rank 2: Overseer, Gallant, maximum Beauty, Organizer, Unyielding Defender, Flexible Leader, Military Engineer.
• Rank 3: Conqueror, Reaver, Holy Warrior and every terrain expert.
• Personal schemes (seduction...) succeed more often: up to +30 %.

[size=5][b]Bloodline[/b][/size]
• Children of a Son of Mars are born with the [i]Latent Blood of Mars[/i] and awaken at 16.
• Share the blood with your family, spouses, courtiers or vassals.

[size=5][b]Powers (decisions)[/b][/size]
• [b]Raise the Legion of Mars[/b]: an army of legionaries appears in your capital (up to 12,000 levies + 30 elite regiments).
• [b]Celebrate a Triumph[/b]: prestige, gold and the love of your vassals.
• [b]Right of Conquest of Mars[/b]: pressed claims on every neighbouring realm.
• [b]Proclaim the Imperium Invictum[/b]: take the Byzantine (Eastern Roman) Empire title and get huge permanent bonuses.
• [b]Feast of Venus[/b]: charm your spouses, courtiers and vassals.

[size=5][b]Powers (right-click)[/b][/size]
• [b]Single Combat[/b]: kill any mortal. Against another Son of Mars, the strongest wins.
• [b]Subjugate in the Name of Rome[/b]: a weaker independent ruler becomes your vassal, no war needed.
• [b]Charm of Venus[/b]: the target falls in love with you at once and becomes your lover.
• [b]Enthrall[/b]: the target becomes your devoted friend.
• [b]Share the Blood of Mars[/b] and [b]Show of Force[/b].

[size=5][b]Also[/b][/size]
• Two elite men-at-arms: Legionaries of Mars and Praetorian Cavalry of Mars.
• Random events: arena champion, the legions' acclaim, the oracle of Mars.
• Game rules: inheritance on/off, fast progression, how strong the AI can get.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
• Made for CK3 1.20. No DLC required
• Does not overwrite any vanilla file: compatible with most mods, including Divine Ascension (be a Living God and an Imperator Invictus at once!)
• Should work in an existing save
• English and French

Made with the help of AI (Claude).
